arguments.value: James J. Brady was a United States district judge for the Middle District of Louisiana, serving from 2000 until his death in 2017 and taking senior status in 2013. Born in St. Louis, Missouri, he earned a B.A. from Southeastern Louisiana College in 1966 and a J.D. from Louisiana State University Law School in 1969. Brady practiced law privately in Louisiana from 1969 to 2000, served on the Louisiana Board of Tax Appeals from 1975 to 1980, and was an adjunct professor at Louisiana State University in 1985, 1987, and 1990.
